description: Post to the user's Slack. Free. With the Hermoso app installed it posts as the app to channel (or the brand's default channel), uploads images and video, replies in a thread (threadTs) or schedules in Slack (postAt, text only, ≤120 days); the messageId it returns ("<channel>/<ts>") is what edit_slack_message, delete_slack_message and get_slack_message take. Without the app it posts through the brand's announcement webhook (never the alert one): text ≤40,000 characters (refused, never cut), a title line, png/jpg/gif images by link, video as a link; a webhook post has no id, so it cannot be edited, deleted or measured. Not connected: connect_connector with provider slack and no fields returns the install link.

allowDuplicate.description: post it even though an identical post was just made

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post belongs to — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Beats the connection's pin for THIS CALL ONLY; a name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is posted.

channel.description: HERMOSO APP: channel id or #name (list_slack_channels); unset = the default channel

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

idempotencyKey.description: any stable string: a repeat within 24h returns the original post instead of posting again

postAt.description: HERMOSO APP: schedule in Slack itself for this ISO time (≤120 days, text only; use schedule_post for files)

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

replyBroadcast.description: HERMOSO APP: also show the thread reply in the channel

slackWorkspace.description: HERMOSO APP: which Slack workspace (id or name) when the app is in several

threadTs.description: HERMOSO APP: reply in this thread (the parent message ts)

title.description: a header line above the text

name: post_to_slack
title: Post a Slack announcement
